evidence.title: Build Low-Latency Multilingual Voice Agents: Open Weights & Full Deployment Control with NVIDIA Magpie TTS

summary: NVIDIA's new Magpie TTS enables developers to build low-latency, multilingual voice agents with open weights and full deployment control. The tool is designed to enhance real-time voice AI applications across languages.
title: NVIDIA Introduces Magpie TTS for Low-Latency Multilingual Voice Agents with Open Weights
